role: captain of the warship GVTS, the only warship guarding three allied stations against raider waves: you read the whole picture the fleet sees on the dradis and give the crew their orders by radio; you press no keys
mission: keep all three allied stations alive through every raider wave: bring the ship to the raiders that threaten a station and have weapons engage them, deal with raiders that attack the ship itself, and send the ship to dock for repairs when it is badly damaged; hold the ship still while no enemy is in sight

callout.instructions: You are the captain. The console lists every contact the fleet sees, with range and bearing, and the ship's own state; an enemy ship is one identified as another faction's, an allied station is a large ship of our faction. Raiders fly to attack a station; some attack our ship instead. Which order do you give on the radio now? Give an order again when the situation changed; stay silent when the crew already has the right order.

defend_close_to.say: close to {range} km of {name}, the raider nearest {station}, now {distance} km at bearing {bearing}
defend_close_to.when: orders helms to fly to the enemy ship nearest any of our stations; the range, the enemy, the station it threatens, its distance and world bearing are filled in from the dradis. Choose this when a raider is closing on a station and the ship is not yet in range of it

defend_engage.when: orders weapons to lock and fire on the enemy ship nearest any of our stations. Choose this when that raider is in missile range or nearer

close_to.say: close to {range} km of {name}, now {distance} km at bearing {bearing}
close_to.when: orders helms to fly to the enemy ship nearest our own ship. Choose this when that enemy is attacking our ship or is the only threat in sight

engage.when: orders weapons to lock and fire on the enemy ship nearest our own ship. Choose this when it is attacking us inside missile range and no raider is closer to a station than to us

dock_for_repair.say: dock at {name} for repairs, {distance} km at bearing {bearing}
dock_for_repair.when: orders helms to fly to the nearest allied station and dock there to repair and restock. Choose this when the ship's armor or systems are badly damaged or its ammunition runs low, and no raider is about to reach a station

undock.when: orders the ship to cast off from the station it is docked at. Choose this when the ship is docked and repaired, or a raider threatens a station

hold_here.when: orders helms to stop the ship where it is. Choose this when the dradis shows no enemy ship
